_comment: Mix levels and optional asset overrides for the procedural audio (see Docs/Audio.md).
gain: per-sound volume multiplier for the synthesised bank.
sfx_assets: replace a synthesised sound with an imported asset, e.g. "explode_large": "/Game/Audio/SFX_BigBoom.SFX_BigBoom".
music_assets: replace a procedural music mood (menu, tension, battle, victory, defeat) with an imported track.
